name: @ai-agent-ledger/mcp-gateway
stderr:
Missing child server command after "--".

Usage: agentledger-mcp-gateway [options] -- <child server command> [args...]

Example (wrap the filesystem server, block deletions, expose kill switch):
  agentledger-mcp-gateway --policies ./policies.json --dashboard 4000 \
    -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem ./work

Options:
  --policies <path>        policies.json (templates, raw rules, natural language)
  --ledger <path>          audit NDJSON file (default ./agentledger-audit.ndjson)
  --agent-id <id>          agent id in ledger entries (default mcp-gateway)
  --run-id <id>            session run id (default: generated UUID)
  --dashboard <port>       start dashboard: REST kill switch + WebSocket feed
  --dashboard-token <tok>  require X-AgentLedger-Token on dashboard requests
  --name <name>            server name advertised to the client
